spans.claim: Madeleine Van Norman was found dead with a dagger wound in the library

spans.span: What they saw was Madeleine Van Norman, seated in a chair at the library table.

spans.claim: A written note implying suicide was found but later proven to be written by Cicely Dupuy
spans.anchor: I am wholly miserable, and unless the clouds lift I must end my life
spans.span: Immediately he read it aloud: I am wholly miserable, and unless the clouds lift I must end my life.

spans.claim: The house was securely locked with no signs of forced entry except the front door with a latch-key
spans.anchor: There are strong bolts to doors and windows
spans.span: There are strong bolts to doors and windows?

spans.claim: Schuyler Carleton entered the house at quarter after eleven
spans.anchor: I heard the sound of a latch-key and I heard the front door open at exactly quarter after eleven
spans.span: I heard the sound of a latch-key and I heard the front door open at exactly quarter after eleven.

spans.claim: No blood stains on Madeleine's right hand despite blood on dagger handle
spans.anchor: there is absolutely no trace of blood on the right hand of the body of Miss Van Norman
spans.span: Although the dagger, which you may see still lying on the table, has several blood-stains on its handle, there is absolutely no trace of blood on the right hand of the body of Miss Van Norman.

spans.claim: The note was written with a soft pencil unlike the hard pencil on the library table

spans.claim: Cicely Dupuy wrote the false note and showed suspicious behavior
spans.anchor: I did write that paper, and it was the confession of my heart
spans.span: I did write that paper, and it was the confession of my heart.

spans.claim: Tom Willard left the house at 10 pm and returned secretly
spans.anchor: I went away from this house about ten o’clock
spans.span: I went away from this house about ten o'clock, taking with me a suit-case full of clothes.

spans.claim: A cachou was found on the drawing-room floor, uncommon in Mapleton
spans.anchor: I found next morning on the drawing-room floor a cachou

spans.claim: Fleming Stone discovered the ash-chute in the fireplace as a secret entry
spans.anchor: Here is where the assassin entered. He came up through this hole in the fireplace

spans.claim: The ash-chute opening measures nine and one-half inches by thirteen and one-half inches
spans.anchor: the oval opening measured exactly nine and one-half inches by thirteen and one-half inches
spans.span: Although the rectangular plate was several inches larger each way, the oval opening measured exactly nine and one-half inches by thirteen and one-half inches.

spans.claim: Tom Willard confessed to the murder and then fatally wounded himself
spans.anchor: I picked up the dagger and told her what I was about to do, being fully determined to stab her and then myself
spans.span: I picked up the dagger and told her what I was about to do, being fully determined to stab her and then myself.

spans.claim: Schuyler Carleton refused to disclose his errand and timeline
spans.anchor: I decline to say

spans.claim: Cicely Dupuy fled the house fearing interrogation
spans.anchor: Miss Dupuy was gone away. On the train, with luggage

spans.claim: The note was not written at the library table on the night of the murder
spans.anchor: it is not the pencil which was used to write that message
spans.span: A few marks made by it upon a bit of paper will convince you at once that it is not the pencil which was used to write that message.

spans.claim: The murderer entered and exited through the cellar window and ash-chute

spans.claim: Tom Willard had the physical ability and knowledge to use the ash-chute
spans.anchor: he could go through a much smaller man-hole than another workman who weighed only one hundred and sixty pounds
spans.span: He told me that he could go through a much smaller man-hole than another workman who weighed only one hundred and sixty pounds, simply because he knew how.

spans.claim: The cachou found in the drawing-room links Tom Willard to the crime scene
spans.anchor: Mr. Willard is or has been an expert engineer, and for many years held such a position
spans.span: I discovered to-day that Mr. Willard is or has been an expert engineer, and for many years held such a position in a large factory right here in Mapleton.

spans.claim: Tom Willard's confession reveals the true murderer and method
spans.anchor: I drove the dagger home to her heart. She died without a sound
spans.span: This threw me into a frenzy, and with one thrust I drove the dagger home to her heart. She died without a sound, and I pulled out the dagger to turn it upon myself.
